# Wiki.js

Wiki.js is a modern, powerful wiki engine: Markdown and visual editing, a page tree, search, and Git or other storage sync.

## What it is

**What it is:** a wiki engine. Pages are written in Markdown or a visual editor, organised in a tree, searchable, and can be backed up to Git or synced with other storage. Version 3 is a rewrite of the long-running 2.x line.

**Sub-tags:** wiki (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1).

**Icon:** `icon.svg` is a neutral generated initials icon, not the upstream logo.

## How it is packaged

- **Image:** upstream `ghcr.io/requarks/wiki:3.3.1` (the same digest as the `:3` tag). It runs as the `node` user (UID/GID 1000) on port 3000. This package starts it as UID 1000.
- **Database:** PostgreSQL 18 (`postgres:18.6-alpine`) in a native sidecar on 127.0.0.1 only, trusting local connections, so no password or Secret exists. The Alpine image is used because the Debian one fails the app gate (see `metabase`, `paperless-ngx`); its `postgres` user is UID 70.
- **State:** PVC `wiki-js-db` (5 Gi) for the database, and PVC `wiki-js-data` (2 Gi) on `/wiki/data` for Wiki.js's cache, content and repository folders.
- **Health:** startup, readiness and liveness probes on `GET /_healthz`, which answers 200 once the server runs.
- **Security:** `runAsNonRoot`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, all Linux capabilities dropped, `RuntimeDefault` seccomp, no service-account token. One replica with the `Recreate` strategy.

## First run

From the upstream documentation, https://js.wiki:

1. Open the web UI (port 3000) from the OneMind dashboard.
2. The setup page asks for the administrator email, password and site URL. Fill them in and finish.
3. Create your first page.

## Known limits in this package

- The site URL in the setup page should be the port-forward address until OneMind has an app proxy.
- The database is only reachable inside the pod; back it up with the volume (the Backups feature), not with an outside `pg_dump`.
- Licence: AGPL-3.0 (GitHub licence API). There is no research licence-matrix row yet (brief 30 B10).

## Why this app is blocked

The CI app gate (`sdk/tools/app-gate`, contract §9.4) computed tier **blocked** for this app on 2026-11-13 (ci-apps run 43468044446, job `gate (wiki-js)`). The gateway lists a blocked app in the Market but refuses to install it (§10.3, §11.1). The app is kept, not hidden, and the gate was not weakened. The smoke test passed. Reasons from that run:

- `ghcr.io/requarks/wiki:3.3.1`: CVE-2026-42216 and CVE-2026-42217 in libopenexr (fixed in Debian 3.2.12-1~deb13u1), plus CRITICAL CVE-2026-44172 and CVE-2026-49261 in libmariadb-dev with no fix yet.
- `postgres:18.6-alpine` sidecar: CVE-2025-68121 in Go stdlib v1.24.6 (fixed in 1.24.13 and 1.25.7).
- No research licence-matrix row (AGPL-3.0), so not preinstallable on sold boxes until one is added.

**What would unblock it:** an upstream Wiki.js image rebuilt on patched Debian packages, a postgres image built with a fixed Go stdlib, and a licence-matrix row.
